cases.name: pack-valid-memory
cases.description: A pack generator's <valid> predicate rejects and redraws until it holds
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="rare" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="P"><gen type="template" value="common.logistics.container_iso6346"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{P}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: weighted-pack-behind-an-interpolated-address
cases.description: A row-dependent address reaching a WEIGHTED pack draws per row, honouring the shares
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="rare" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Sex"><gen type="text" value="male,female"/></sequence><sequence name="Name"><gen type="template" value="person.${{Sex}}.firstName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Sex}} ${{Name}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: uniq-exact-on-disk
cases.description: uniq= in disk mode goes through the exact on-disk engine: fingerprint piles, then a verify
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="u" local="en" mode="disk"><sequence name="K" uniq="true"><gen name="a" type="text" value="a1,a2,a3,a4"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="b1,b2,b3,b4,b5,b6,b7,b8"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{K.a}}-${{K.b}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: uniq-exact-on-disk-tight-pool
cases.description: The on-disk uniq at the edge of what the pool allows, where the verify has real work
cases.config: <tdc><env count="9" seed="u-tight" local="en" mode="disk"><sequence name="K" uniq="true"><gen name="a" type="text" value="p,q,r"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="x,y,z"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{K.a}}${{K.b}}</data></line></block></tdc>
